verdict.rationale: ReadMe's own Agent and AI chat panel let admins create, edit, and research documentation, and inline AI applies plain-language instructions to selected text. Linter rules are also written in natural language. However, the evidence only covers content authoring and editing, not operating the wider product (configuration, versions, branches, publishing, and admin tasks), so coverage of 'operate the product' is partial. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of non-content operations such as settings, versions, branches, and publishing; independent or hands-on corroboration of how well the Agent follows commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
